bullets.text: WhatsApp Status Update Revived - **WhatsApp** relaunches its 'About' feature, enhancing visibility for user status updates.
YouTube's Messaging Feature Returns - **YouTube** tests in-app messaging, allowing users to share videos and chat directly.
Letterboxd Launches Movie Rentals - **Letterboxd** introduces a digital video store for renting films directly on its platform.
Group Chats in ChatGPT - **OpenAI** rolls out group chat functionality in **ChatGPT**, enhancing collaborative conversations.
AI Scam Protection Boosted - **Google** enhances AI-driven scam detection for **Pixel 9** users in India amid rising fraud.
London Thieves Prefer iPhones - Report reveals thieves in London increasingly returning non-iPhone devices to victims.
Microsoft PowerToys Upgraded - **Microsoft** enhances **PowerToys** with on-device AI for its Advanced Paste feature.
AI Browser Comet Launches - **Perplexity** introduces its AI-powered Comet browser on Android, enhancing search capabilities.
Cross-Platform Sharing Enabled - **Google**'s Quick Share now supports file transfers with **Apple**'s AirDrop on Pixel 10.
AI Image Creation App Mixup - New app **Mixup** allows users to create AI images from photos and doodles.
